401-1829-3944-8125.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
Your life total is at least 2.
401-1829-3944-8125.description:
Cast Blood Pet by paying {B}.
When Blood Pet enters the battlefield, Davvol triggers, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, Decaying Soil and Vindictive Vampire trigger.
Resolve the Decaying Soil trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Blood Pet from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Vindictive Vampire trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent
Repeat.

206-240-574-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Vish Kal ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Vish Kal equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat from step 2.
206-240-574-5470.notes: Depending on how many counters this combo puts on Vish Kal, you can activate its last ability to kill some number of creatures.

539-1462-2511-3821-4679.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two lands excluding Yenna that can tap for mana.
539-1462-2511-3821-4679.description:
Activate up to four lands excluding Yenna by tapping them, adding at least {2}
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake
When the Peregrine Drake token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna and up to four other lands.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the Peregrine Drake token, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur.
Repeat

3175-4247-4775.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

2292-2738-4871-5687.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Skittering Precursor, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Skittering Precursor trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1.
Repeat.

790-2384-6833-7824.description:
Cast Windfall by paying {2}{U}, causing each player to discard their hand and each opponent to draw cards equal to the greatest number of cards discarded this way, and you to draw twice that number due to Bard.
Psychosis Crawler triggers for each card you draw, and Scrawling Crawler triggers for each card opponents draw.
Resolve the Psychosis Crawler triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life for each card you drew.
Resolve the Scrawling Crawler triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life for each card they drew.
790-2384-6833-7824.notes: The end result is that each opponent will lose life equal to three times the largest amount of cards a player has in their hand. It is recommended to play this combo when it will be lethal for opponents, as it will give them some card draw in additional to the lifeloss.

2459-2997-3652-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
2459-2997-3652-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

109-232-1235-7487.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting any two creatures.
Holding priority, cast Fork by paying its mana cost, copying Twinflame, with the copy targeting Priest of Urabrask and Zealous Lorecaster.
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask and Zealous Lorecaster with haste.
When the Priest of Urabrask and Zealous Lorecaster tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Zealous Lorecaster trigger, returning Fork from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

855-1806-2060-6797-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Corpsejack Menace.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

2034-2820-4460-4679.description:
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Angelic Renewal.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Yenna, adding {C}{C}.
When Yenna dies, both Angelic Renewals trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing to sacrifice either Angelic Renewal and return Yenna from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.

549-3259-5953-6965.easyPrerequisites: Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control.
549-3259-5953-6965.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
549-3259-5953-6965.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Aya of Alexandria trigger.
Resolve the Aya of Alexandria trigger, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1734-2511-6132.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from exile to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2922-3678-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
2922-3678-6879.description:
Play Obscura Storefront.
When Obscura Storefront enters, it and Retreat to Emeria trigger.
Resolve the Retreat to Emeria trigger, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Obscura Storefront.
Resolve the Obscura Storefront trigger from step 2, causing you to sacrifice it, search your library for an applicable land and put it onto the battlefield tapped, and gain 1 life.
Haru triggers, returning Obscura Storefront from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-5043-5078-6766.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Alela triggers, creating a 1/1 Faerie creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Faerie, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Repeat.

1339-5686-6713.easyPrerequisites: You control an additional creature with flash and/or haste
1339-5686-6713.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another creature with haste or flash.
When the creature dies, Shadow triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

292-1887-3693.description:
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Walking Ballista.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.
292-1887-3693.notes: You can remove counters to deal damage to creatures you control, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on them due to Rite of Passage.

1461-4050-4078-6458.easyPrerequisites: Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
1461-4050-4078-6458.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 4.
1461-4050-4078-6458.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Wurm tokens, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Chainer by paying {B}{B}{B} and 3 life, putting Wurmcoil Engine from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Wurmcoil Engine enters the battlefield, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Wurmcoil Engine, adding {B}.
When Wurmcoil Engine dies, it triggers, creating two 3/3 Wurm artifact creature tokens.
When the Wurms enter the battlefield, Thunder of Unity triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life and each opponent to lose 2 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Wurms, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.

851-4508-5880-5929.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1274-2034-3490-3641.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-2034-3490-3641.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Heliod triggers, holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Heliod trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

914-2921-5140.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-2921-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{B}.
Repeat.
914-2921-5140.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

1781-3401-5803.manaNeeded: {2}, plus an additional {11}{U}{U} minus {1} for each other artifact you control
1781-3401-5803.notablePrerequisites:
Kitsa has power 2 or greater and does not have summoning sickness.
Artifacts you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
1781-3401-5803.description:
Activate Thran Forge by paying {2} causing Kitsa to become an artifact until end of turn.
Cast Blinkmoth Infusion by paying {12}{U}{U}, minus {1} for each artifact you control.
Kitsa's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Holding priority, activate any number of mana-producing artifacts you control, adding at least {2}.
Activate Kitsa's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Blinkmoth Infusion.
Resolve the copy of Blinkmoth Infusion, untapping all artifacts you control.
Repeat from step 4.

1393-4986-5034-5256--18.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Aether Channeler, causing target player to mill cards equal to Aether Channeler's power.
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Cast the other artifact with MV<=1 by paying at most {1}.
Teshar triggers, returning Aether Channeler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aether Channeler enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Sol Ring from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Aether Channeler, causing target player to mill cards equal to Aether Channeler's power.
Cast Sol Ring by paying {1}.
Teshar triggers, returning Aether Channeler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aether Channeler enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the other artifact from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

526-1817-4200.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one nontoken non-Warrior creature with base power 4 or greater.
526-1817-4200.description:
Cast Icewind Stalwart by paying {3}{W}.
Holding priority, cast Double Major by paying {G}{U}, copying the Icewind Stalwart spell.
Resolve the copy of the Icewind Stalwart spell.
When the Icewind Stalwart token enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking any non-Warrior you control with base power 4 or greater.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Life Finds A Way triggers, creating a token copy of the Icewind Stalwart token.
Repeat from step 4.

919-2051-2546-2657.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two additional land cards in hand.
919-2051-2546-2657.description:
Activate Lonely Sandbar's cycling ability by paying {U} and discarding it.
 Surly Badgersaur's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Lonely Sandbar ability, causing you to mill three cards and return Life from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Ayula's Influence by discarding a land card.
Surly Badgersaur's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Ayula's Influence ability, creating a 2/2 Bear creature token.
Repeat from step 4 one additional time.
Activate the three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Cast Life from the Loam by paying {1}{G}, returning Lonely Sandbar and two other lands from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

676-2100-2633.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creature tokens.
676-2100-2633.description:
Cast Searing Touch with buyback by paying {R}.
Urabrask triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent and adding {R}.
Resolve Searing Touch, dealing 1 damage to any target and returning it to your hand.
Repeat.

259-4428-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Thassa triggers, blinking Halo-Charged Skaab.
When Halo-Charged Skaab enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each player to mill two cards and put Time Warp on top of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next durn, drawing Time Warp during your draw step.
Repeat.

250-779-3442.description:
Activate Patchwork Gnomes by discarding Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's third ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Patchwork Gnomes ability, regenerating it.
Repeat.

326-5005.description:
Target yourself with Chain of Smog and copy your own Chain of Smog, targeting yourself again.
Repeat the process enough times to defeat your opponent with the Ral, Storm Conduit's static ability.
